chars.SISTER: SISTER: a Moroccan young woman about 22 with long wavy black hair, wearing an oversized mustard-yellow hoodie and grey sweatpants
chars.FRIEND: FRIEND: a Moroccan young woman about 22 with short curly dark-brown hair, wearing a red-and-white striped long-sleeve pyjama top
chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a Moroccan young man about 20 with a short fade haircut and light stubble, wearing an olive-green bomber jacket over a white t-shirt and black jeans
chars.PAL: PAL: a Moroccan young man about 20 with curly hair, wearing a royal-blue tracksuit with white stripes

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, vertical. Seen from a half-open bedroom doorway at night in a modest Meknes apartment: SISTER and FRIEND lying side by side in one single bed under the same floral blanket, pulled up to their chins, giggling and whispering to each other, faces clearly visible and close together, warm bedside lamp light. Head-to-waist framing, subjects in the center, calm edges. Playful, curious mood. No text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, vertical. NARRATOR sitting by the window of a crowded city bus in Meknes in the morning, holding his school bag, frowning and staring into space, deep in suspicious thought, one eyebrow raised. Subject centered, calm background. No text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, vertical. In a Moroccan living room with a traditional sedari sofa, SISTER and FRIEND hugging each other tightly and laughing, cheek to cheek, very affectionate, faces visible. Subjects centered, calm edges. Light comic mood. No text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, vertical. NARRATOR sitting at a desk in a Moroccan university classroom, ignoring the blackboard, chin on his hand, confused and troubled expression, a faint thought bubble with a picture of two girls sleeping under one blanket above his head (no words). Subject centered. No text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, vertical. NARRATOR and PAL sitting side by side in a small Moroccan neighbourhood gaming cafe, holding game controllers, PAL laughing and celebrating, NARRATOR distracted, glancing at his phone. Evening neon light. Subjects centered. No text.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, vertical. Night street in a Meknes residential neighbourhood: NARRATOR stepping out of the back seat of a dark sedan in front of a modest apartment building door, the driver silhouette inside, NARRATOR looking up at a lit window on the upper floor. Subject centered. No text.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, vertical. Dark apartment hallway at night: NARRATOR halfway up the stairs, frozen, leaning toward a closed bedroom door with warm light and shadows moving under it, hand cupped to his ear, wide suspicious eyes. Subject centered, face visible. No text.
